description:
International TRADE STATISTICS — countries' import/export flows, partners, rankings and balances from UN Comtrade
    (official customs data). NOT securities trading: it never places, routes or executes an order. Pick `mode`; each mode reads a subset of the params (see each param's note).

codes.description: Product: HS code(s) OR a plain-English product ('copper','cars'), server-resolved. REQUIRED for flows/top_partners/top_traders; omit for balance → TOTAL (all goods).
codes.title: Codes

context.description: OPTIONAL but RECOMMENDED — the user's FULL request VERBATIM (any language). Used to pick the right code + SUPPLY STAGE (ore vs concentrate vs refined) and leaf-vs-family granularity for a `codes` concept.
context.title: Context

freq.description: annual (default) | monthly (YYYYMM, goods only). flows only.
freq.title: Freq

min_value_usd.description: top_traders only: floor to drop tiny-base noise.
min_value_usd.title: Min Value Usd

mirror.description: Also return the partner-reported figure + discrepancy (China esp.). flows only, goods.
mirror.title: Mirror

mode.description: flows = one country's trade of a product over time · top_partners = a country's biggest trading partners for a product · top_traders = rank COUNTRIES by trade of a product (world/region) · balance = a country's trade balance (surplus/deficit).
mode.title: Mode

order.description: top_traders only: desc (default) / asc; for streak = run direction.
order.title: Order

period.description: Year '2023' / list '2020,2021' / range '2015:2024' / 'lastN' / 'latest'. DYNAMIC — never hardcode. Defaults vary by mode.
period.title: Period

reporter.description: Reporting country — name/ISO/M49 ('Thailand'/'THA'/'764'), server-resolved. REQUIRED for flows/top_partners/balance.
reporter.title: Reporter

scope.description: top_traders only: world (default) / continent / subregion / econ group (asean/eu/g7) / CSV ISO-2.
scope.title: Scope

name: trade
title: Trade Flows & Rankings
